text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: "It's finally here: the Arima Kinen...! I've got a feeling things are gonna get wild this year!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky is riding the biggest wave right now!
My money's on Seiun Sky, no question!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I hope she's okay...
I hope Seiun Sky doesn't throw off her pace...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every spectator's eyes were on Seiun Sky.
However, the girl in question...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If I let my guard down,
it feels like I'd get completely stabbed right through~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To avoid Grass-chan's blade, the only way is to keep dodging, huh...
That's gonna be exhausting.
choice_data_list: Grass Wonder isn't the only opponent to worry about.
Grass Wonder isn't the only one you're up against, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you're adding another threat here!?
What a mean Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Though they're definitely all looking at me.
It's tough being this popular, it really is."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, no, there's no way someone would laugh
in such a tense situation... a...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...♪
Ah, I couldn't help laughing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Because there are so many formidable rivals, you know? It really gets me thinking about how to conquer them."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: When you think about it, it sounds a little... no, actually, super fun~♪
